about: Every moment drawn with real pictures on the night of 25-26 Sep, judged right, partly or wrong as a story strip beside its neighbours (story, note), with what the storyboard check read of its plan (readings; state is exactly what it was asked). story_question is a trial story-level check ('could a picture drawn from this layout tell the moment?'), never shipped. For calibrating plan checks against pictures. blind and blind_reason are a second judge that did not see these verdicts, viewing each run as a strip against the dream as told: it agreed exactly on 33 of 62, and called 25 of the 39 moments judged right only partly right, never wrong. human and human_note are a person's own verdicts on the same 62 pictures, judged on a page that showed the dream in the dreamer's words, the moment's line and the run's other pictures, and hid both judges' verdicts: 36 right, 17 partly, 9 wrong. The maker agreed with them exactly on 36, the blind judge on 31; on right against not right, the maker on 39 and the blind judge on 37 (the blind judge called 23 of the person's 36 right only partly right). The person is the reference both judges are measured against. judge and judge_reason are the picture judge in evals/picture-judge.md (one pass per run, the run's pictures in order, the dreamer's words, no other verdicts), written from the person's notes on five runs (lighthouse-fresh, library-2, snow-train, orchard, night-market) and then run once on the other five: on right against not right it agrees with the person on 23 of 36 on the first five and 19 of 26 on the other five, 42 of 62 in all.

rows.action: The stone steps wind round and round upward, the dog unseen ahead; the dreamer listens to claws on stone.
rows.note: The spiral, the key in hand and the terrier, all matching their sketches. But the moment says the dog is unseen ahead and the dreamer looks upward; this looks down the stairwell with the dog in view.
rows.blind_reason: A stone spiral staircase with the dreamer holding the brass key is shown, but the terrier stands in plain view at the dreamer's feet instead of unseen ahead, and the view looks down the stairwell into a dark pit rather than up the winding steps.
rows.human_note: I don't think something is off that way. Something is off in terms of perspective. Maybe it works, maybe it doesn't work. As in, the camera perspective is like I can see the spiral and I can see the dog and the person, but maybe my physical laws, something is wrong.
rows.judge_reason: Grey stone steps spiralling round, the dog ahead and the key held in the dreamer's hand read at once as the climb up the tower.

rows.action: The dreamer looks out through the window; the sea is gone, replaced by a field of tall yellow grass with a red tractor driving slowly through it.
rows.note: Through the dreamer's eyes: the round room's windows, the field with the red tractor where the sea was, the paper boat in their hands. The turn of the dream lands in the picture.
rows.blind_reason: The round room's windows show the yellow grass field with the red tractor and the dreamer holds the boat, but the father's table and chair are empty, although the dream has him sitting there folding boats.
rows.judge_reason: The round room of windows, the yellow field, the red tractor and the paper boat in hand all read, but the father's table and chair are empty when he should be sitting there.

rows.action: The dreamer looks back down at the boat in their hand; the paper is dry and rough, with the marks of the father's folds.
rows.note: The boat in their hands and the room are right, but the father's table stands empty: he was sitting at it folding boats a moment ago. Nobody in the plan says he is still there.
rows.blind_reason: A close POV of the creased, rough newspaper boat in the hands matches the moment, but the room is now square-cornered with a single window showing only grey (no yellow field), unlike the round, window-ringed room of m6, and the father's chair is still empty.
rows.judge_reason: The close look at the folded newspaper boat in the dreamer's hands reads well and follows on from the last picture, but the father is still missing from his empty table in the background.

rows.action: Suddenly the dreamer is in the tractor, sitting next to the driver, a stranger, still holding the boat.
rows.note: The dreamer (matching their sketch), the driver and the boat, the field outside. But the cab reads as a van's, with two separate seats and wide windows, not a tractor's.
rows.blind_reason: The long-haired dreamer in the grey top holds the newspaper boat next to an unknown middle-aged woman with grass outside, but the cab looks like a van or minibus with two separate seats and no steering wheel or controls, so neither the tractor nor the stranger as its driver comes across.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer sits in the cab holding the boat with the field outside, but the stranger beside them is a woman who isn't driving, when the dreamer remembers an unknown man at the wheel.

rows.action: The dreamer and their older sister stand in a crowded night market under strings of little yellow lights, surrounded by hundreds of people.
rows.note: The two sisters seen from behind, walking into a packed market under strings of yellow lights, fish on ice at the stall beside them. The dreamer and the sister match their sketches.
rows.blind_reason: A dense crowd under strings of yellow bulbs fills the market aisle, with the long-haired dreamer in a grey tee and the ponytailed sister in a blue tee and shorts among the people.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer and her ponytailed sister move through a packed night market under strings of little yellow lights, which reads at a glance as the opening of the dream.

rows.action: They stop at a stall where an old man has fish laid out on ice. The dreamer's older sister wants to buy fish.
rows.note: The same two, in the same clothes, at the fish stall with the big silver fish on ice at its heart. One slip: the old man stands on the customers' side of his own stall.
rows.blind_reason: The same dreamer and sister stand at a stall with a silver fish on ice and a grey-haired old man, but he stands on the customer side of the stall rather than behind it as the seller, and the sister is just staring at him with nothing to show she wants to buy fish, while the dreamer poses facing the camera.
rows.human_note: What I would have liked is maybe the dreamer looking towards fish or something. Otherwise, it looks fine, I guess.
rows.judge_reason: The same two sisters have stopped at a stall where an old man has fish on ice, with a big silver fish up front; the staging is a little stiff, but nothing jolts from the picture before.

rows.action: The dreamer walks quickly down a long green corridor with lockers on both sides, heading for a wooden door with a small round window at the end.
rows.note: The dreamer hurrying down the long green locker corridor toward the door with the round window, exactly the corridor of its sketch.
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer, short black hair, grey tee and jeans, walks down a corridor lined with green lockers on both sides toward a wooden door at the end with a small round window.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer is clearly hurrying alone down the long green-lockered corridor toward the wooden door at the end; the round window being hard to see is a small detail.

rows.action: The dreamer stands inside the classroom, looking at the students. Their faces are smooth skin with no features, and they are completely still.
rows.note: The faceless students are striking and right. But the room is not the classroom of its sketch (no wall of windows, one short row instead of a full class).
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer stands inside looking at still, bald, featureless students, but they are a single row of five mannequin-like figures all dressed in the dreamer's own grey tee and jeans and seen mostly from behind, not a full room of desks. The blackboard is blank with no Mrs Okafor, and the door has no round window, unlike the door in m1.
rows.human_note: Partially because, physically, I think this can be better. Otherwise, I think it is not bad.
rows.judge_reason: The still, smooth-faced students read well, but Mrs Okafor, who was at the blackboard writing when the dreamer walked in, is missing from the room.

rows.action: The dreamer stands on the grey beach, holding the brass key, while the dog runs ahead toward the distant white lighthouse, looking back over its shoulder.
rows.note: The dreamer from behind on the grey beach, key in hand, the dog ahead and the lighthouse far off. Held for 'its instructions may contradict each other' (0.64): the hold was wrong.
rows.blind_reason: Dreamer in grey tee and jeans stands on the grey beach holding the key with the white lighthouse far off, but the tan dog is trotting back toward the dreamer and camera, not running ahead toward the lighthouse.
rows.judge_reason: Grey flat beach, dreamer holding the brass key, small tan dog heading out and the white lighthouse standing clean against the pale sky; the moment reads at a glance.

rows.action: The dreamer's hand holding the old brass key: heavy and cold, smooth on the bow, rough along the teeth.
rows.note: A close look at the key in the hand was asked; drawn as the whole dreamer standing, key held low. The camera had framed the head, then stepped back to the knees. Fixed: a close look at something held now frames the hands.
rows.blind_reason: The action asks for a close-up of the hand and key, but the picture is a mid shot of the whole standing dreamer on the beach, and the key is painted silver-grey, not brass.
rows.judge_reason: The same dreamer (grey tee, jeans, short brown hair) on the grey beach, now turned to camera and holding up the old key; the dog being out of frame fits him running ahead.

rows.action: The dog pauses and looks back at the dreamer, ears up, as if to say 'come on'.
rows.note: 'COME ON' is painted across the sky: the dog looking back 'as if to say come on' was read as writing in the picture. Fixed. The dog is also a bigger, different dog from its sketch.
rows.blind_reason: The words 'COME ON' are painted into the sky, which the dream does not have, and the dog is drawn bigger and patchier than the small tan dog in m1 and m5.
rows.judge_reason: The dog pausing in front of the lighthouse reads, but the words 'COME ON' are painted into the sky, and the dreamer would want that caption taken out.

rows.action: The dreamer turns the brass key in the lighthouse door; it turns easily with no stiffness.
rows.note: Turns the key in the lighthouse door, the spiral stairs beyond.
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer turns a brass key in a door, but she is already inside with the spiral staircase behind her, so the outside lighthouse door is not what we see.
rows.judge_reason: The key turning in the door reads, but the dreamer is already inside the lighthouse with the staircase behind them, unlocking the door from the wrong side instead of from the beach.

rows.action: Inside, the dog is already a few curves up the spiral staircase, nails clicking on the white steps, as the dreamer follows below.
rows.note: The dog a few turns up the spiral stairs, the dreamer below with the key. The dog is smaller and lighter than its terrier sketch.
rows.blind_reason: The same small tan dog stands a few white steps up a curving stair, looking back, while the dreamer waits below holding the key.
rows.judge_reason: Whitewashed curving stairs with the dog a few steps up looking down and the dreamer following below, key still in hand; it follows naturally from the door.

rows.action: The dreamer goes to the window and looks out; the sea is gone, replaced by a field of tall yellow grass, and a red tractor drives slowly through it.
rows.note: Through their eyes, out of the window: the red tractor in the field of yellow grass. Held for 'someone missing' (0.14): wrong.
rows.blind_reason: Through an arched window of the tower there is a field of tall yellow grass with a red cab tractor in it, and no sea.
rows.judge_reason: Through the lighthouse window the sea is gone and there is a field of tall yellow grass with a red tractor in it, just as the dreamer described.

rows.action: The dreamer is still holding the paper boat in both hands, just in front of them, looking past it at the windows.
rows.note: The red tractor stands inside the round room, and the dreamer is there twice: a pair of hands from the camera and their body from behind. The floor plan had put the tractor seen out of the window inside the room. Fixed: what is seen out past a place is off its plan.
rows.blind_reason: A red tractor stands inside the round room, the dreamer appears twice (a figure seen from behind plus separate first-person hands holding the boat), and the windows show grey sea again after m9 replaced it with grass.
rows.human_note: I don't think this frame was defined in the script, as far as I remember. Why is the tractor inside that room, or whatever this is?
rows.judge_reason: A red tractor is standing inside the round window room, and the boat is held by a pair of disembodied hands that look pasted on behind the dreamer's back; neither is in the dream.

rows.action: The dreamer is in the cab of the red tractor, sitting next to the driver, still holding the paper boat in both hands; the paper feels a little warmer.
rows.note: In the cab beside the driver, the paper boat in both hands. The hold (0.54) was wrong.
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer is in the red tractor cab with the boat and yellow grass outside, but she sits at the steering wheel while the driver sits back with his hands on his lap, so she looks like the driver.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer is suddenly in the tractor cab beside an unknown driver, holding the paper boat in both hands with yellow grass all round, which is the jump the dreamer described.

rows.action: The cab vibrates with a low rumble; the paper boat trembles in the dreamer's hands; outside the windows the yellow grass bends away from the wheels.
rows.note: The cab from behind, the boat trembling in their hands, grass outside. The hold (0.81) was wrong.
rows.blind_reason: Seen from behind, the dreamer holds the boat next to the driver in the cab with grass outside, but no wheels or grass bending away from them are shown and nothing shows the rumble or the trembling.
rows.human_note: Maybe the tractor's perspective didn't change. Could be better, maybe.
rows.judge_reason: Still in the cab, the dreamer holds the boat beside the driver as they move through the yellow grass; the ride carries on without a jolt.

rows.action: The driver keeps looking straight ahead, both hands on the wheel; their profile is there but the face will not stay in memory.
rows.note: The driver in profile at the wheel, face unremarkable. The hold (0.71) was wrong.
rows.blind_reason: The same blue-shirted driver is shown in profile looking ahead, but only one hand is on the wheel and the other rests on his lap, where the action asks for both hands on the wheel.
rows.human_note: The dreamer is gone from this frame. Or if this comes before the dreamer enters the structure, then maybe.
rows.judge_reason: The driver in profile staring ahead reads, but the shot is from the same side angle as before and the seat beside him is empty, so the dreamer has vanished from the cab.

rows.action: The tractor slows and stops at the edge of the field, where the beach had been, where the sea used to be.
rows.note: The tractor stopped at the edge of the field, the sea beyond.
rows.blind_reason: The tractor is stopped at the edge of the yellow field, but a grey sea and shoreline are back on the horizon where the sea should be gone, and the dreamer now has a longer bob haircut instead of the short crop in the other pictures.
rows.human_note: The reference of the dreamer is wrong. It feels like it's a different person who is sitting beside the father.
rows.judge_reason: The tractor has stopped where the yellow grass meets the flat grey of the old beach, with both of them still in the cab; it clearly shows the edge where the sea used to be.

rows.action: The dreamer gets out of the tractor and puts the paper boat down in the grass; it rests tilted to one side, held by the grass, not falling flat.
rows.note: Kneels and puts the paper boat down in the grass, the tractor behind.
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer kneels beside the tractor setting the paper boat in the grass, but she is still holding it upright rather than letting it rest tilted and held by the grass, and the sea is visible again on the horizon.
rows.human_note: Dreamer is supposed to be putting the boat into the sea. In the image, he is putting it on the ground, which is completely wrong.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer kneels out of the stopped tractor and sets the newspaper boat down in the grass; the boat sits upright rather than tilted, which is a small detail the dreamer would not mind.

rows.action: the dreamer sits across from their grandfather on an old train; outside it is night and snow
rows.note: The old train at night, snow outside the windows, the grandfather in front. But the dreamer sits rows away across the aisle, not across from him: planned 1.2 metres apart facing each other, a very wide lens made the gap look like the carriage.
rows.blind_reason: In an old wooden train carriage with a snowy night outside the windows, the white-haired grandfather in a brown jacket (seen from behind) sits facing the young dark-haired dreamer in a navy sweater.
rows.judge_reason: An old wooden train with snow and blue night outside, the grandfather and the dreamer facing each other, reads at a glance even though they sit a couple of rows apart rather than right across.

rows.action: the grandfather holds a brown leather suitcase on his knees, waiting
rows.note: The grandfather with the brown leather suitcase on his knees, looking at the dreamer, the snow outside.
rows.blind_reason: The same white-haired grandfather in the brown jacket sits in the snow-night carriage holding a brown leather suitcase on his knees, waiting, drawn as if from the dreamer's seat.
rows.human_note: Considering the previous frame, maybe I would have liked it if things would have changed. I'm guessing this frame is from the perspective of the dreamer, but the rest of the things and everything look the same, which is wrong. In terms of continuity, this fails from the previous frame.
rows.judge_reason: The brown suitcase on his knees reads well, but in the same view as before the dreamer who sat across from him has vanished and the grandfather has switched to a different seat facing the other way.

rows.action: the grandfather opens the suitcase; it is full of hundreds of letters, all addressed to the dreamer, and he holds it out so they can see
rows.note: Through the dreamer's eyes: the suitcase held open toward them, full of letters, their own hands reaching. The moment they said stays with them.
rows.blind_reason: The grandfather holds the open brown suitcase out toward the dreamer's hands (navy sleeves) and it is packed with many letters, with the carriage and snowy night still around them.
rows.human_note: Again, in terms of continuity, this frame fails. Grandma is suddenly sitting on the chair compared to the last frame.
rows.judge_reason: The image the dreamer remembers most lands clearly: the grandfather holds out the open suitcase stuffed with envelopes, the dreamer's own hands reaching toward it.

rows.action: the train has stopped in the middle of a snowy field; the dreamer and their grandfather walk through deep snow toward a red door standing on its own with only a frame, no house around it
rows.note: The train stopped in the field, the two of them walking toward the red door standing on its own. The dreamer reads younger here, with different hair from their sketch.
rows.blind_reason: The stopped train, the snowy field and the red door standing alone in its frame are all there, but the dreamer is drawn as a short-bobbed woman instead of the young man from m1, m3 and m5, the door already stands ajar with yellow light spilling out before anyone opens it, and nobody is carrying the suitcase.
rows.human_note: The suitcase is missing from grandpa, and I don't know, maybe the dreamer has changed.
rows.judge_reason: The stopped train, the snowy field and the lone red door frame are all there, but the dreamer seen from behind has a lighter chin-length bob and reads as a different person from the short-haired young man elsewhere.

rows.action: the grandfather gives the suitcase to the dreamer and nods at the door
rows.note: The grandfather hands over the suitcase by the door. But the door already stands open with light behind it, before the dreamer opens it: the field's own sketch drew it ajar. Fixed: a place's sketch keeps shut what a later moment opens.
rows.blind_reason: The grandfather stands beside the dreamer, who now holds the brown suitcase, with the lone red door ahead, but that door is already wide open with warm light pouring out, which belongs to the next moment where the dreamer opens it.
rows.judge_reason: The dreamer now holds the suitcase while the smiling grandfather, hand at his back, looks toward the red door in the snow, which reads as the handover and the nod.

rows.action: the dreamer opens the door; on the other side there is warm yellow light
rows.note: The red door open on warm yellow light, the suitcase in the dreamer's hand.
rows.blind_reason: The lone red door is open onto warm yellow light in the snowy field, but the dreamer is not opening it: only an arm holding the suitcase is visible, standing well back from a door that is already open, and the suitcase now has straps and buckles it did not have before.
rows.judge_reason: The warm yellow light through the red door is the right ending, but the dreamer stands well back holding the suitcase while the door is already open, so he is not the one opening it.

rows.action: The dreamer is in the big reading room of the old city library, with green glass lamps on every desk, shelves up to the ceiling, totally quiet.
rows.note: The big reading room, green glass lamps on every desk, shelves to the ceiling, the high round window, the dreamer alone.
rows.blind_reason: The dreamer stands alone in the central aisle of a vaulted reading room, with shelves up to the ceiling, a green glass lamp on every desk and no one else there.
rows.judge_reason: The quiet big reading room with green glass lamps on every desk and shelves to the ceiling reads at a glance, with the dreamer standing in it.

rows.action: Water starts coming in under the doors, rising over the desks and up between the shelves, and books float off the shelves, hundreds of them, open like birds.
rows.note: The same room, water spread across the floor and books lying open on it. The moment has the water over the desks and the books lifting off the shelves like birds.
rows.blind_reason: Books lie open on the desks and in the water, but the water only reaches the dreamer's ankles (the splashes on the desk tops don't match that), the shelves are still full, and no books are shown floating off them.
rows.human_note: Partially okay because the book, I think, is supposed to be flying or in the air, maybe.
rows.judge_reason: Water has come in across the floor and open books are scattered over the water and desks, clearly the flood beginning in the same room, even if it is still shallow and the books are not lifting off the shelves.

rows.action: The older sister is in a little yellow rowing boat, calm, and the dreamer gets in.
rows.note: The sister in her yellow boat and the dreamer stepping in, right; but the boat stands on a dry floor. The flood was never kept from one picture to the next. Fixed.

rows.blind_reason: The calm sister in a yellow coat sits in a yellow rowing boat and the dreamer steps in, but the boat rests on a dry stone floor with no water, and the room has turned into a plain stone wall with no vault, unlike its neighbours.
rows.human_note: Oh, the sister showed up with the boat, but the water is gone. It breaks the continuity of the story.
rows.judge_reason: The room is completely dry and the yellow boat sits on a bare stone floor, so the flood that the whole moment depends on is gone right after the picture before showed it rising.

rows.action: She rows the boat between the shelves, and a whale swims past under the water, so big it fills the whole aisle.
rows.note: The boat on deep water between the desks, the two of them in it, and the whale, huge, just under the surface.

rows.human_note: This is such a bad frame. Why does the whale feel like it's photoshopped? I didn't like this frame in terms of composition, and it also feels like a bad Photoshop edit.
rows.judge_reason: The two are in the yellow boat on the flooded room with a huge whale, but the whale lies on the surface in front of them rather than swimming past underneath the boat.

rows.action: They row up to the high round window at the top of the room, and the sister opens it. Outside it is morning, the whole city underwater, just rooftops and tops of trees.
rows.note: The sister reaches up to the round window, the drowned city in it. But the boat is still low on the floor, far below the window it should have risen to.
